notes.title: (Horror yuri VN) The Final Prize is Soup - out now on Steam
notes.content:
If you played Lachesis or Atropos, you may enjoy this new title by the same developer, 4noki!
If you played, please support us by leaving a review, so we can bring more titles like this to you on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903060/The_Final_Prize_is_Soup/

Features include:


~45k word main story
2 main heroines (2 major endings / 6 dead ends)
Cinematographic storytelling
Accessibility options
A CG gallery, a music gallery, dev notes, and an achieved endings screen
Steam achievements
Original music tracks
New dev Q&A
King route side story

notes.title: New yuri game from Lachesis or Atropos developer!
notes.content:
Hi! Did you enjoy horror VN, Lachesis or Atropos? The developer, 4noki, has a new game called The Final Prize is Soup, and it's coming to Steam on August 27. It's about a series of death games in the afterlife, and maybe some yuri romance! You could even get back together with your ex (but first, you need to survive the games...)

Yes, it's another horror yuri game, we have a type (and maybe you do too)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903060/The_Final_Prize_is_Soup/

You who are unqualified to drink Meng Po's soup, you have been chosen for the game of life. Three worlds, three rounds. Win all three and you may avert your fated death. Lose any and your bones are forfeit for tomorrow's lunch broth.

Good luck. Our ghosts have prepared their takeout containers, all plastic, non-microwaveable.

Features:

 ~45k words
 2 major endings and plenty of dead ends
 5 CGs
 Cinematographic storytelling
 Accessibility options
 A CG gallery, a music gallery, dev notes, and an achieved endings screen
 Steam achievements, Steam cloud


Wishlist here
it will be yours on August 27!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2903060/The_Final_Prize_is_Soup/

notes.title: UPDATE: July 18th release date for Lachesis or Atropos
notes.content:
Quill Yuri is excited to announce we're publishing 4noki's horror mystery yuri visual novel, Lachesis or Atropos, on Steam.

We pushed the date on Valve's recommendation; the previous date had reduced algorithm visibility due to overlap with the Summer Sale. Thank you for the patience!

A private investigator visits a small town after recovering from a coma. She searches for her mentor's lost beloved, but the very eyes she was born with, those that can see the black strings of hate, drag her down into the darkness of conspiracy.

Out on July 18th, 2023. Wishlist on Steam now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2234770/Lachesis_or_Atropos/
